title: feat(spec): page:header placedActions draws every placed header action, refused beside an actions list (#30018)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBUP5hwg8gDjEhnYwJtWWFgb)_

Fixes #30018

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：记录页的页头组件 `page:header` 新增一个可选开关 `placedActions`（布尔，没有默认值）。写 `true`，页头画出该对象所有放在 `record_header` / `record_more` 的动作，实时读取；不写或写 `false`，`actions` 列表照旧，写了哪些就只画哪些。
- 为什么改：按你对 #29951 的裁决 A（记录 6624172200）。作者想要「对象上放好的动作全都显示」时，今天只能手抄 id 列表，别的包后来加的动作不会出现。这是 spec 先声明的一半，渲染器由 #29951 的 ui 半边接上。
- 风险与回滚：只放宽，不收窄。互斥规则：`placedActions: true` 和 `actions` 列表同时写（空列表也算）会被 `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint` 和页面保存门以 `component-props-invalid` 错误拒绝，消息点名两个键，让作者只留一个；`false` 加列表可以。这个组合以前因为是未知键本来就被拒，所以没有已通过的页面会变红。渲染器还没读这个键，写了也不改变显示。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`（新键、`.refine` 互斥规则和它的消息常量）；`ui/apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`（ui 下唯一一行：豁免条目，#29951 的 ui 半边落地时删掉）；`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md`（唯一受管文件，一行）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ui/component.test.ts -t placedActions`，预期 8 个用例全绿，其中「refuses … beside an authored actions list」断言错误路径是 `placedActions`、消息含 `Keep one`。
- 需要你做的：本 PR 因 `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md` 一行成为受管（Tier H），席位复核后请你批准合并。

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up #29951 — this diff names the key in `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md` and in the docs, marked not drawn yet; no eval exercises it while no renderer reads it, so the eval and the qualifier drop ride with the reader.

## What changes

- **`PageHeaderProps.placedActions`** (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`): `z.boolean().optional()` beside `actions`, no default, so an unset key stays unset in the parsed output. `true` asks the header to draw every action of the page's object whose `locations` include `record_header` or `record_more`, read live from the object's metadata. Omitted or `false`, the `actions` list rules as today: an authored list is the whole set (#11592).
- **Refused together.** The schema now ends in a `.refine` that refuses `placedActions: true` beside an authored `actions` list, an empty list included, at path `placedActions`. The message names both keys and tells the author to keep one: `actions` for a curated list that is the whole set, or `placedActions: true` for every placed action. The refine keeps the closed `strictObject` constructor, so unknown keys are still refused. `@objectstack/lint` `validateComponentProps` safe-parses `ComponentPropsMap['page:header']`, so the refusal reaches `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint` and the page save door as a `component-props-invalid` error. `defineStack` does not parse the properties bag, so nothing changes there.
- **Docblocks.** The `actions` TSDoc and `.describe()` now name the opt-in and the exclusivity. The new key's describe opens with `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]`.
- **Liveness, honest PLANNED.** Component-level keys have no ledger row (the walk stops at the undrilled `page/regions` container), so the record is the describe marker plus a `PLANNED RECORD (#30018 …)` sentence in `packages/spec/liveness/page.json` `_note`, measured at main `eee41490`: `PageHeaderRenderer` in `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx` reads no `placedActions`. The reader is #29951's ui half (the renderer and the three platform record pages).
- **`dropped-refinements.baseline.json`** gains `ui/PageHeaderProps` (1 site, root). The rule depends on the value `true`, which none of the projectable arms in `shared/refinement-projection.ts` states, so the published JSON Schema still accepts the pair and the parse refuses it. The row is the one the build printed.
- **Generated:** `packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json` gains `ui/PageHeaderProps:placedActions`.
- **One line under `ui/`, as the seat ruled:** `UNPUBLISHED_EXEMPTIONS['page:header.placedActions']` in `ui/apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`, citing #29951. The parity test's reverse direction reads the workspace spec dist and would otherwise refuse a spec key no `page:header` registration input publishes. #29951's ui half must strike this entry when it declares the input (`carries no stale unpublished-key exemption` refuses it once the input is published).
- **Docs:** `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx` (the `actions` row names the alternative; a new `placedActions` row) and `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx` (one sentence), both saying the console renderer does not draw it yet.
- **Skills (Tier H, the only governed file):** `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md`, the `page:header` catalogue row names `placedActions: true (all placed; not drawn yet)`. The token ratchet has zero headroom on this file, so the row is paid for by deleting a redundant clause from the print-page paragraph ("and a `full` page with no regions"), which the condition just before it already states.
- **Changeset:** `@objectstack/spec` minor, `@objectstack/skills` minor, an ordinary minor. Nothing ships in 18.3.x.

- **Generated reference:** `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx` regenerated by `gen:docs` (the new row and the rewritten `actions` describe), not hand-edited.

### Qualifiers #29951 drops when the reader lands

The key is marked "not drawn yet" in six places, all true today and all false once the renderer reads it: the describe marker in `component.zod.ts` (the generated reference follows it), the `page.json` PLANNED sentence, the parity-test exemption, the `pages.mdx` row ("Declared ahead of the console's header renderer…"), the `layout-dsl.mdx` sentence, and `pages.md` ("not drawn yet").

## Why

Ruling A on #29951 (record 6624172200): a record page's header should be able to say "every action placed on this object" without copying ids, so an action another package places at `record_header` / `record_more` shows up without a page edit. #11592 made an authored `actions` list the whole set, which stays the default; the opt-in is a separate, explicit key, and the two cannot be set together because they would be two different answers to the same question. This PR is the spec half only. Nothing ships in 18.3.x.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/ui/component.test.ts`, new describe "PageHeaderProps placedActions — every placed header action, or the authored list, never both", with the five cases the card asks for plus three:
  1. `placedActions: true` alone is accepted and kept.
  2. An `actions` list alone parses as before, and no `placedActions` key is materialized.
  3. `placedActions: true` beside `['convert_lead']` and beside `[]` is refused as exactly `[{ code: 'custom', path: 'placedActions' }]`; the message contains `` `placedActions: true` ``, `` `actions` `` and `Keep one`.
  4. `placedActions: false` beside an `actions` list is accepted.
  5. Absence leaves the key unset (`{}`, `{ title }`, `{ title, actions }`).
  6. A string `'true'` is refused as `invalid_type` at `placedActions`.
  7. `ComponentPropsMap['page:header']` is `PageHeaderProps` and refuses the same pair.
  8. The describe opens with the PLANNED marker.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-component-props.test.ts`, new describe for #30018: the pair gives one `component-props-invalid` error at `pages[0].regions[0].components[0].properties.placedActions` (both list forms), with `where` set to `page "probe_page" · page:header` and a message naming both keys; silent on true alone, a list alone, and false beside a list; through `runAuthoringRules('validate', …)` the finding is an error.

## Acceptance notes

- Spelling, no default, true/omitted/false meanings: as the card states. See What changes.
- Refused together, message names both keys and says keep one; `false` beside `actions` accepted: tests 3 and 4, plus the lint door test.
- `actions` docblock and describe rewritten to name the opt-in: yes.
- Honest PLANNED liveness naming #29951 as the reader: the describe marker and the `page.json` sentence.
- One docs line and one skills line: `pages.mdx` and `layout-dsl.mdx` (docs), `pages.md` (skills).
- Artifacts regenerated and committed: `authorable-surface/ui.json`, the dropped-refinements row; `check:generated` result in Verification.
- Out of scope, untouched: the objectui reader and the three platform pages (`sys_user_detail`, `sys_organization_detail`, `sys_approval_request_detail`).
- Other open PRs that edit `PageHeaderProps`: none. At head `371cb0fd`, I fetched the head of each of the 19 open PRs and diffed it against its merge base with `main`. None touches any of this PR's 12 files, and none changes a `PageHeaderProps` or `placedActions` line in `component.zod.ts`.
- Out-of-scope finding, not changed here: `skills/objectui/guides/page-builder.md` still lists the retired `page:header` key `breadcrumb`, so a skill teaches a key the closed shape refuses. I left it alone because that guide describes what renders and naming `placedActions` there would be untrue; the stale `breadcrumb` mention is worth its own card.

## Verification

All runs went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`. The box was shared, so the timings are wall-clock on a shared machine.

- **Full build:** `pnpm build --concurrency=2`, 119/119 tasks, exit 0.
- **Spec tests:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`, 811/811 files, 24378 passed plus 1 todo, exit 0.
  - The first run went red on one test: `dropped-refinements.test.ts`, "header totals match its body". The ledger's `measured` totals now count the new row (251 schemas, 1019 sites).
- **Spec typecheck:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`, exit 0.
- **Repo pins:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test:repo`, 90/90 files, 1539 tests, exit 0.
- **Generated artifacts:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`, 14/14 artifacts, exit 0.
  - The first run flagged `content/docs/references/**` as stale, because the describe changed. `gen:docs` regenerated it, and that commit is in this PR.
- **Authorable surface:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:authorable-surface`, exit 0.
- **Lint door test:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-component-props.test.ts`, 121 passed, exit 0.
- **ui parity test:** `registry-inputs-spec-parity`, run through the console project against the built spec dist (which carries `placedActions`), 261 passed, exit 0.
- **Skills token ratchet:** `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, exit 0. `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md` is 5669 tokens against a ceiling of 5669 (+0). The file has 427 lines before and after (22673 → 22674 bytes). The sum of all `SKILL.md` files is unchanged: 4536 lines and 226744 bytes. No `SKILL.md` was edited.
- **Changeset gate with this body:** `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main --event` exits 0. It reads `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: added`, finds no `major`, and grades no moved package `patch`.
  - Control: the same body with `Metadata-protocol: none` exits 1, because `packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json` moved.
- **dispatch-gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` printed 113 commands at head `371cb0fd`. I ran each one byte for byte, and all 113 exited 0.
  - `--ran` reconciliation: "113 derived, 113 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN".
- **Ablation, once:** `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the pair predicate in `component.zod.ts` with `(header) => header !== null`. The anchor went from 1 hit to 0, and the blob changed from `68041b88` to `00fa1529`.
  - `vitest run --project local src/ui/component.test.ts` then went red: 2 failed and 359 passed. The two failures were the pair refusal and the `ComponentPropsMap` refusal. The other six tests in the describe stayed green.
  - Restored: the blob is back to `68041b88`, matching HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
